items_predate_note: Items are sentences of published prose that predate this project entirely; the gold is the word actually present in the sentence. No detector of ours authored, selected or labelled them. Target is a SEEDED RANDOM known content lemma, not the first.
task_caveat: Naming a word from its neighbours is close to cloze, where co-occurrence counting is a strong baseline BY DESIGN. A loss says the store is a worse co-occurrence record than a counter. It is NOT proof the substrate cannot build an auditable knowledge store; that needs a separate cell with an independent gold.
